annotations.title: Stop or start sharing a local app

description: Stop, start, or restart sharing a local app published from this machine, with the qURL CLI. stop is reversible and keeps the CRID, so prefer it to delete_crid. start needs the local app to be reachable again. restart re-registers the share and ends sessions that are open. Applies only to local apps, not to remote URL resources.

action.description: stop takes a local app offline and keeps its CRID; start brings it back; restart re-registers it and ends open sessions

crid.description: The CRID of the resource to start, stop, or restart. Copy it exactly; never trim or change case.

name: set_crid_sharing

name.description: Self-declared publisher name; not proof of identity

resource_id.description: Equals a valid crid when present; otherwise a legacy publisher key that management tools do not accept.
